title: Account Executive I/II, Parkinson's Disease - Knoxville, TN
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Candidates will be hired at a level commensurate with their experience; this role will be filled at either grade 18 or grade 19. This field-based role will cover Knoxville, Johnson City, and Bristol, Tennessee, as well as Asheville, North Carolina.
The Parkinson’s Disease (PD) Account Executive (AE) is responsible for maximizing business opportunities with approved on-market products (drug device combination) for the Parkinson’s Franchise. The PD AE will develop and maintain strategic business relationships with accounts through interactions with approved Movement Disorder Specialists, Neurologists, Advance Practice Providers, Health Care Professionals, nurses, executive level personnel, department managers, and various other support staff. Business relationships will focus on increasing education on product benefits/risks and awareness of current therapeutic gaps, consistent with approved labels, developing new business and expand current business, maximizing resource utilization, and increasing sales aimed at achieving sales plan for the assigned Parkinson’s product portfolio. The PD AE will also focus on building and maintaining successful and compliant working relationships with Parkinson’s Advocacy, Support groups, and other groups that support Parkinson’s patients.
Key Job Responsibilities:
Delivers effective on-label technical and scientific presentations/sales calls utilizing approved data and resources to appropriately highlight the benefits and risks of the product and create awareness of product solution addressing gap in therapeutic area - resulting in sales quota achievement.
Leverages opportunities to understand and address customer needs. Builds and maintains relationships across accounts that result in opportunities to benefit patients and HCPs.  Consistently partners with AbbVie in-field and in-house teams to identify, design and/or adapt appropriate approaches and tactics.
Serve as lead US Commercial contact with targeted accounts in assigned geography. Appropriately and compliantly addresses needs of customer and patients through expert knowledge of AbbVie’s environment of care approach.
Creates, implements and communicates strategic and tactical plans for targeted accounts. Monitor and report sales progress. Provide routine communications to all internal and external (as applicable) stakeholders.
Attend and actively participate in local neurology society meetings, conferences, patient programs, support groups, advocacy events, etc., some of which occur in the evenings or weekends. Represent AbbVie and assigned products at such venues to build or enhance relationships and education on product, increasing awareness. Channel key information, developments or findings to internal partners/stakeholders. All attendance and communications in these forums are within OEC and Legal guidance with all product discussions on-label.
Based on individual accounts, customers and geographical dynamics, create and development business strategy, territory account plans, align appropriate resources to support tactic execution and adjust as needed.
Remain current on all clinical, market, and payer developments, trends, and issues specific to Parkinson’s Disease.
Complete all AbbVie required training and maintain adherence to all company policies and OEC/Legal procedures.
An essential requirement of your position is to meet health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements for entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but not limited to, background checks, drug screens, and proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases.
Represent AbbVie as a partner of choice in the Parkinson’s and Neuroscience space with HCP and Patient Organizations
Driving a personal auto or company car or truck, or a powered piece of material handling equipment
Bachelor's degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
Minimum 2 years sales or account management experience.
3+ Years of Health Science Field or Sales experience with a minimum of 2 years in pharmaceutical sales. In lieu of degree 8+ Years of Health Science Sales experience with minimum of 4 years in pharmaceutical sales.
Demonstrated ability to network and partner effectively across functional areas.
Excellent organizational/project management and demonstrated leadership skills.
Proven record of managing multiple stakeholders in complex environments.
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements.
An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements & for any associated liability for failing to do so. AbbVie has resources available to you to help answer questions you may have.

title: Animal Behavior Technician I
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. The Behavioral Technician I supports AbbVie’s Behavioral Management program (BMT). This role is responsible for operant conditioning, enrichment, behavioral monitoring, and positive reinforcement for research animals. Provides direction and support to Animal Care Technicians and other AbbVie employees who perform animal husbandry in accordance with the company animal enrichment program. Elevates any concerns or inconsistencies with animal behavior and the enrichment program to the appropriate authority (manager) for action.
Responsibilities
Assist with performing positive reinforcement training of animals. Communicates skills and enrichment program requirements amongst research groups and Comparative Medicine staff. These include but are not limited to those for behavior related tasks, enrichment, socialization, operant conditioning, chair training, pole and collar training, target training.
Assist with training of staff on standardization and continued productivity as related to operant conditioning and enrichment related strategies.
Enables higher performance by building and maintaining strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of team.
Identifies potential improvements to the program; remains flexible, open to suggestions and experimentation for improvement on enrichment and operant conditioning related strategies. Embraces the ideas of others, nurtures innovation and assists with the progression of innovation to reality.
Assists with daily tasks associated with animal enrichment animal enrichment, such as scheduling, prep, distribution to animals, evaluation of effectiveness, and enrichment area/supply maintenance.
Assists with entry and upkeep of behavioral, training and enrichment forms/database(s); Maintains documentation of all animal trainings (timelines, progress, comments, concerns, etc.)
Works with moderate work direction, remains flexible, performs multiple projects simultaneously, meets deadlines, and maintains sanitation standards.
Assists with incorporating the 3R’s into the Behavioral Management program
Attends applicable training and workshops pertaining to lab animal enrichment/behavior; participates in on-site enrichment trainings and committees where required.
Provides animal husbandry duties as required; Required weekend husbandry (or animal enrichment/ operant conditioning) rotation commitment
High School/GED is required AND at least 3 years prior technical experience in laboratory animal science setting OR relevant degree in related discipline (biology, animal behavior, animal science, veterinary technology) with at least two years laboratory animal science experience.
At least two years of animal husbandry/enrichment/ behavior/ training experience.
Certification by the American Association for Laboratory Animal Science (AALAS) at the Assistant Laboratory Animal Technician (ALAT) level; eligibility for LAT certification
Knowledge of basic regulatory requirements.
Communication Skills – Ability to concisely communicate key issues to stakeholders.
Analytical Skills – Ability to assess issues that arise, seek multiple perspectives, gather more information as needed, and identify key issues that need to be addressed.
Computer Literacy – Basic competence of spreadsheets, word processing and email, and knowledge of computerized maintenance management systems and purchasing systems.

Trial Surveillance & Analytics (TSA) is a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, statisticians, statistical programmers, and AI specialists in Data & AI Acceleration, part of AbbVie's Data and Statistical Sciences, focused on transforming clinical trial surveillance through AI-enabled data integration, analytics, and automated reporting. TSA delivers integrated medical monitoring and safety surveillance capabilities that enable timely, trusted, and actionable insights across the clinical development lifecycle.
Data Scientists play a key role in designing, developing, and scaling innovative analytics solutions that support clinical trial surveillance, medical monitoring, safety evaluation, and data-driven decision-making. This position combines analytical expertise, business acumen, and modern AI-enabled approaches to transform complex clinical data into meaningful insights that improve operational efficiency and support patient safety. The team is AI-native: agentic coding and AI tools are part of how we program, analyze, and report.
Responsibilities:
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand surveillance, analytics, and reporting needs and translate them into scalable, fit-for-purpose solutions.
Develop analytical products, automated workflows, and AI-enabled capabilities that support trial surveillance, medical monitoring, and safety assessment activities, including streamlined solutions from data to analytics to reporting.
Apply statistical methodologies, machine learning techniques, and advanced analytics approaches to generate actionable insights from clinical trial data.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of integrated analytics platforms, data pipelines, and reporting solutions that support ongoing monitoring and safety surveillance.
Transform complex clinical and operational data into clear visualizations, decision-support tools, and meaningful business insights for clinical and safety teams.
Apply AI to transform statistical programming: use agentic coding and generative AI to generate, validate, and document code and outputs, contribute to migrating legacy SAS programs to R, and measure resulting efficiency gains.
Collaborate with team members to establish best practices, reusable analytical assets, and standards that ensure high-quality and consistent user experiences.
Support continuous innovation through experimentation, proof-of-concept development, and evaluation of emerging analytical and AI technologies.
Contribute to operational excellence initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve processes, reduce manual effort, and enhance data quality and reporting efficiency.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, GCP, ICH guidelines, AbbVie policies, and departmental quality standards.
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree statistics, analytics, bioinformatics, data science or equivalent field.
2-5 years of experience in data science, analytics, statistical programming, data engineering, or related disciplines.
Complete or Full / Career proficiency in R, Python or other statistical languages and packages.
Intermediate-level knowledge of statistical and data mining techniques.
Intermediate proficiency with visualization tools such as Spotfire, PyDash/Plotly, or equivalent platforms.
Experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or generative AI technologies to business problems.
Experience developing automated reporting, data products, or end-to-end analytical solutions.

Familiarity with clinical data standards (e.g., CDISC SDTM/ADaM) and clinical development processes preferred.

title: Principal Research Scientist
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data- and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration. Operating within the APEX Enterprise Advanced Analytics and Innovation team, this role sets the multi-year science vision for personalized commercial engagement and is accountable for the technical strategy, methodology, and scientific rigor of the AI/ML and statistical solutions that power it. Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.
Key Responsibilities
Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.
Supervisory / Management Responsibilities
This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.
Key Competencies
Scientific Engineering Depth: Deep expertise in machine learning, causal inference, and generative AI, combined with strong engineering discipline in reproducibility, deployment, and enterprise integration.
AI Fluency and Bias to Action: Uses AI hands-on in daily work to prototype, analyze, and build; critically evaluates AI output; and turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
Business Judgment and Problem-Framing: Translates ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped problems, connects technical choices to commercial value, and sets long-term technical direction while staying close to delivery.
Stakeholder Navigation and Executive Influence: Reads organizational dynamics to build alignment across commercial, regulatory, and technology partners, earning trust as a thought partner to win support from senior leaders.
Thought Leadership: Challenges conventional thinking and sparks meaningful analytical debate with peers and executives.
Education
Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline required; Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field strongly preferred.
Required Experience
8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science (or 6+ years with a PhD), with a track record of delivering production-quality models that drove measurable business impact.
Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for a portfolio of AI/ML solutions and influencing decisions of senior business leaders.
Experience building personalization, recommendation, decision-optimization, or marketing-science solutions, in any industry.
Deep hands-on expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods, to measure business impact.
Demonstrated hands-on experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, agent frameworks) to prototype and deliver solutions, with concrete examples that can be walked through during the interview process.
Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and distributed data processing.
Experience productionizing AI/ML solutions in cloud environments, including deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Track record of leading initiatives across complex, cross-functional stakeholder environments and presenting to executive audiences.
Preferred Experience
Commercial analytics experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences, including familiarity with data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, APLD, or similar Rx, claims, and engagement data.
Experience in omnichannel analytics, such as journey analysis, touchpoint measurement, closed-loop measurement, or next-best-action for HCP or patient engagement.
Experience with advanced ML and optimization methods, including reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, transformers, and other approaches for sequential or recommendation use cases.
Experience building LLM-based and agentic AI systems, including orchestration frameworks, evaluation, and integration through APIs and pipelines.
Experience with cloud ML platforms and MLOps tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, and MLflow.
External visibility through conference talks, publications, patents, open-source contributions, or recognized industry thought leadership.
Experience working in agile product development environments.

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Production Technician I executes manufacturing processes in formulation, encapsulation, primary and secondary packaging with oversight by Supervision. Sets up equipment for routine processes. Identify and resolve performance related equipment issues in a timely and efficient manner while adhering to GMP guidelines and procedures to meet or exceed target OEE. Execute assigned jobs and maintains operating conditions within the desired range. Communicates all operational events and issues with appropriate individuals. Identifies opportunities for improvement throughout the operations and assists in the implementation of changes both in physical operations and written documents. Displays AbbVie behaviors.
Shifts available:
1st Shift - Days (Sun - Tues every other Wed)
3rd Shift - Days (Thurs - Sat every other Wed)
Responsibilities:
Proficient in Team Member responsibilities or equivalent. Knowledgeable of basic jobs in assigned area of responsibility and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) policies. Demonstrates compliance to local and industry quality and safety standards.
Work directly on the line while executing scheduling priorities, daily assignment, and production expectations for the day. Ability to proficiently operate multiple unit operations across the business. Monitor manufacturing process and communicate any issues that arise with appropriate resources.
Directly responsible for setting up, running, blowing, cleaning, and clearing equipment according to the BOP/Master batch record.
Minor troubleshooting on equipment and process related issues and performs repairs. Perform all in process quality checks accurately.
Trains colleagues on equipment and process for which they are a qualified trainer.
Demonstrates AbbVie behaviors – good attendance, teamwork, respectful communications, positive attitude.
Follow all Environmental Health and Safety procedures and guideline policies and participate in safety initiatives.
Complete batch record steps following ALCOA and GMP processes as needed. Maintain audit ready production area and adhere to all regulations and company policies.

Collaborate with internal and external partners to manage risk, resolve disputes, and influence outcomes.
Exhibit knowledge and advise on government-related policy initiatives (e.g., IRA, 340b, PBM reform).
Influence strategic direction by translating legal, regulatory, and industry shifts into actionable guidance.
Help select and direct work of outside counsel, define project objectives and manage the project.
This position reports to a Sr. Associate General Counsel, Oncology Lead.
Required
Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school.
Currently be admitted to the bar in at least one U.S. state and meet the professional licensing requirements of the state in which you practice.
Minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience practicing in-house at a pharmaceutical company, practicing as a member of a nationally recognized law firm in a life sciences or healthcare practice, or practicing as an attorney for a government agency, or any combination of the above.

Background in advising the biopharma, healthcare, or life sciences industry.
Knowledge and understanding of pharmaceutical laws and regulations impacting drug registration and promotion to help business clients assess issues in a highly regulated landscape.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate legal complexity into business clarity.

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. Trial Surveillance & Analytics (TSA) is a newly formed center of excellence in Data & AI Acceleration, part of AbbVie's Data and Statistical Sciences organization. Our mission is to transform how AbbVie conducts ongoing clinical trial surveillance — integrating trial data, analytics and AI so that study teams and patient safety colleagues see emerging safety and efficacy signals early, and can act on them with confidence. This is work upstream, inside ongoing clinical trials, where insight can still change decisions for the study and for patients.
The Senior Manager, Trial Surveillance & Analytics is a hands-on, full-stack data scientist who takes a surveillance question from intake to a working solution. You will work in a small team that owns a capability end to end — from the data, through the analysis, to the tool that study teams use — and you will own your solutions from problem statement to a working product that people use. The team is AI-native from day one: agentic coding and AI agents are part of how we work, with room to experiment and to scale what works. You will combine depth in one area (such as statistical programming and reporting, data integration, data visualization, data science and machine learning, or data and software engineering) with enough breadth across clinical data, analytics and AI to deliver on your own, with the support of the team. As an early member of a new center of excellence, you will help define how it works, the standards it sets and the capabilities it builds, partnering across Global Patient Safety, therapeutic area clinical development teams, Statistics, Statistical Programming and data engineering across the portfolio.
Key Responsibilities:
Frame surveillance problems with stakeholders before building: understand the decision to be supported, design for adoption, and iterate with users.
Design and build data pipelines and analysis-ready, integrated data on SDTM, ADaM and integrated databases to support safety and efficacy surveillance.
Lead blinded, standardized analytics across studies and compounds to detect emerging safety and efficacy signals early.
Deliver reporting — tables, listings and figures, safety reports and listings — and automate it wherever possible.
Develop applications, dashboards and self-service tools that study teams and patient safety colleagues use themselves; drive their adoption and measure their use.
Apply generative and agentic AI across the analysis workflow, build AI agents on the clinical data foundation, and measure the gain in time and quality.
Integrate clinical trial and real-world data where the science requires it, assessing comparability and data quality first.
Lead projects and small cross-functional pods; coach and mentor team members. May include indirect supervision of employees and contract staff.
Represent the team in cross-functional forums and communicate technical concepts and results clearly to non-technical audiences.
Ensure adherence to applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and functional quality standards.
Minimum Qualifications:
MS (with 8+ years of experience) or PhD (with 4+ years of experience) in Statistics, Biostatistics, Bioinformatics, Machine learning and AI or a highly related field.
Experience may be in pharmaceutical, biotech, health technology or related industries.
Strong hands-on programming in R and Python, plus SQL and version control (e.g. Git), with a track record of writing production-quality code for end-to-end analytical pipelines.
Demonstrated experience applying generative or agentic AI to analytical or programming work, with measurable results.
Experience working with clinical trial data (e.g. CDISC SDTM/ADaM) and/or real-world data (e.g. EHR, claims, registries).
A track record of building analytical tools or solutions that were adopted and sustained by their users.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical and technical concepts in plain language and to influence cross-functional partners without direct authority.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience designing and building agentic AI systems (e.g. multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval and evaluation), with a track record of solutions delivered and used in production.
Experience in clinical development, drug safety, pharmacovigilance, clinical trial monitoring or regulatory evidence generation.
Knowledge of clinical trial design and of methods for real-world evidence, such as cohort definition, confounding control and external comparators.
Experience building interactive visualizations and data apps with modern frameworks (e.g. Plotly / Dash, Streamlit, Shiny, React / D3) and deploying on cloud platforms (e.g. AWS).
Familiarity with SAS.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives; formal business or leadership training is a plus.
Publications, presentations or community leadership in data science, statistics or AI.

Job Description
The Opportunity
Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Product, you will be a key technical contributor for Adobe's up-and-coming AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together for hundreds of millions of creators. You will own hands-on buildout of the agent across the full stack and across Adobe's target platforms, from desktop and mobile to web and embedded surfaces. You will help reshape the way the team works in the age of agentic engineering. And you will be getting in on the ground floor to help shape the team and its practices.
This is a rare opportunity to build the engineering foundations of Adobe's soon-to-be most visible AI product — from model integration and agentic reasoning patterns, to production infrastructure and cross-platform delivery. The right person brings deep, hands-on full-stack expertise, proven experience shipping agentic systems, a genuine enthusiasm for transforming how engineering itself is done with AI tools like Claude Code and Codex, and the craft to write production-quality code that holds up over time.
What you'll do
Own full-stack implementation across Adobe's Agentic Product — from LLM integration and agentic reasoning layers, to API surfaces, client runtimes, and platform-specific delivery on desktop, mobile, and web.

title: Sr. Manager Risk & Controls
description:
The Opportunity
Adobe is seeking an experienced risk and controls leader to join the Chief Accounting Office as Senior Manager, Risk & Controls. This role offers high visibility at the crossroads of finance transformation, technology, and compliance. As the embedded risk advisor to the Finance & Tech Transformation Office (FTTO), you will collaborate directly with teams driving product launches, process automation, system implementations, and large-scale business transformation initiatives. Your focus will be ensuring that robust controls are built into solutions from the beginning, enabling innovation to move quickly without introducing compliance risks later.
You will have a meaningful role helping the organization coordinate a growing portfolio of optimization products and transformation programs. You will ensure alignment with SOX, ITAC, and ITGC requirements and support business objectives. This position works closely with internal and external auditors to maintain audit readiness, manage evidence, and lead timely remediation of control gaps across the transformation portfolio.
In this position, you can help guide Adobe’s finance operations as they scale and transform, while developing a risk and controls framework that fosters growth and innovation.
What you'll Do
Risk & Controls for Improvement Products
Partner with Process Optimization product owners to identify control risk (financial reporting, ITGC, access, data integrity) introduced by new automations, RPA bots, or process redesigns before they become available
Design and validate control frameworks for optimization products, while maintaining compliance with SOX and audit requirements
Develop and maintain a comprehensive risk register,control inventory and governance framework across the optimization product portfolio
Act as the expert authority on financial reporting risks, IT Application Controls (ITACs), and IT General Controls (ITGCs for initiatives across the CAO organization
SOX Compliance & Audit Readiness
Act as the main point of contact for SOX-IT and ITGC audit inquiries related to transformation, automation and optimization initiatives
Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, product teams, and business stakeholders to ensure controls are designed, documented, tested, and operating effectively

Maintain documentation standards so that control build decisions are defensible and traceable
Build and Scale the Risk & Controls Function

Define the operating model, processes, tools, and governance required to scale risk coverage as the portfolio grows.
Recruit, develop, and mentor team members, creating clear development paths and a strong culture of accountability and partnership.
Program & Collaborator Management
Manage a portfolio of risk/controls workstreams while multiple optimization and transformation activities take place.
Define and track important metrics for control health, audit findings, and remediation timelines.
Build strong relationships across Finance, Technology, Internal Audit, and Transformation teams to drive a proactive risk management mindset.
Develop and communicate knowledge through written correspondence and verbal presentations.
Document, coordinate, and close open requests from a variety of sources to ensure timely completion.

Required
7+ years in risk & controls, SOX/ITGC compliance, internal audit, or GRC program management, ideally with exposure to both finance and technology domains.
Public accounting firm experience with SOX, audit, or internal audit functions.
Direct, hands-on experience applying ITAC (IT Application Controls) and ITGC (IT General Controls) frameworks, including designing, testing, and remediating controls in live environments.
Demonstrated experience embedding controls into system implementations, RPA/automation programs, or large-scale transformation projects (not just post-facto auditing).
Deep understanding of SOX 404 requirements, audit methodology, and the full audit lifecycle including Test of Build and Test of Efficiency.
Strong collaborator management skills; able to influence without direct authority within Finance, IT, and business teams.
Prior people management experience or demonstrated readiness to build and lead a team.

CPA or MBA certification.
Professional certification preferred: CISA, CIA, or CPA.
Experience with GRC tooling (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow GRC, or equivalent).
Experience with automation or process/workflow platforms (e.g., UiPath, SnapLogic, Signavio, Power Automate) from a controls/risk lens.
Background in Finance Transformation, Shared Services, or Enterprise system (ERP/EPM) implementations.
High emotional intelligence coupled with proficiency in offering challenges in a nuanced, constructive manner.
Practical, hands-on approach with mentorship delivered through example.

title: Community Crisis Investigator
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
When a significant severe safety incident impacts, or threatens to impact, our community or company, the Community Crisis Management (CCM) team works to coordinate a swift and effective response across the company to mitigate any continued damage. The team is responsible and accountable for immediate decisions, managing the cross-functional response to severe safety crises on the platform, keeping Airbnb leadership properly informed and involved, and for alerting relevant team leaders to any root causes or vulnerabilities that may have been uncovered throughout the response.
The Difference You Will Make:
As a Community Crisis Investigator, you carry your own caseload and run the day-to-day response, with a defined check-in point for the calls that set precedent or carry external exposure. You assess incidents and bring what you learn back to the team.
A Typical Day:
Crisis Case Work
Assess incoming incidents and recommend whether a case meets the threshold for crisis implementation, drafting summaries concise and comprehensive enough that the decision-maker can act on them without sending them back.
Outline and drive the case management actions needed for stakeholders to respond effectively, keeping the response moving inside the incident’s timeline.
Research case precedent and consult stakeholders when a case does not fit an established pattern, and bring your recommended option with its reasoning rather than an open question.
Prepare concise overviews and next steps for urgent, monitoring, or implemented cases, and note team updates or housekeeping items during regional check-ins.
Communication and Stakeholder Management
Draft crisis case communication for senior stakeholders, and supply the case detail and assessment that executive notifications are built from.
Keep stakeholders and GCM (Global Crisis Management) leadership current on case status proactively, before they ask.
Hold day-to-day communication with your assigned cross-functional partners: maintain regular contact, come prepared to the agenda, and bring what you learn back to the global GCM team.
Systemic Improvement
Flag where policy, product, or process failed the community member, with enough specificity that the owning team can act. The goal is closing the gap that allowed the incident, not only resolving the incident.
Keep the case management tool accurate for your own cases and raise data or backlog problems you notice, so the team’s view of the global caseload stays trustworthy.
Team Contribution
Review peers’ assessments as a second pair of eyes before submission, checking for errors, missing stakeholders, and recommendations worth adding.
Share what you learn from your cases and stakeholder relationships with the team.
Contribute to team culture and to a working environment where people can do this work sustainably.
Operational Rigor
Maintain case documentation and trackers to a standard that supports accurate analytics and clean handoffs within and across regions.
Complete work within the dedicated SLAs, and raise it early when a case is at risk of slipping rather than after it has.
Your Expertise:
6+ years of experience in customer support or front-line work handling escalated, sensitive cases, including crisis or survivor-facing work such as a crisis line, victim advocacy, emergency response, or trust and safety.
Proven track record of working collaboratively with multi-functional leads in a matrixed organization.
Experience working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to stay focused with a calm demeanor in stressful situations.
Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights and weekends as needed.

title: Senior Partnership Manager
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
Distribution Partnerships team’s mission is taking Airbnb out to the world; working with a range of partners to embed Airbnb in highly trusted and contextually relevant environments to meet guests where they already plan and book their travel, experiences, and services.
The team owns partnerships end to end, from initial ideation, strategy, engagement, and agreement through product launch and ongoing relationship management. Within it, the Business Development (BD) segment owns the front end of the partnership lifecycle: defining strategy, identifying and recruiting partners, structuring commercial agreements, and setting the foundation for long-term partnership success. BD works hand in hand with Partner Management, which grows, measures, and continuously improves each partnership after launch. This role owns partner management for a portfolio of live distribution partners, with approximately 70% of time on day-to-day management and strategic development of existing partners and 30% supporting the team on new partners and renewals, and is growing to become an end to end partnerships leader.
The Difference You Will Make:
We are looking for an experienced, proactive Senior Partnerships Manager to join our Distribution Partnerships team, reporting to the Director, Distribution Partnerships.  You will manage a portfolio of live distribution partners across our verticals, such as financial services, airlines and loyalty programs, and business travel platforms (the mix may change as priorities shift), and support new partner deals and renewals as you grow into the role.
In the future, you will have an opportunity to contribute to the distribution strategy, help define which segments and partners to target, and support negotiations and deal structuring on individual partnerships. You will carry each deal through launch and into long-term growth, establishing the measurement, forecasting, and feedback loops that let the wider team scale the program globally.
Our partnerships are powered by a portfolio of products that are still being built (embedded booking, points earn and pay with points, embeds, and a partner portal), so you will work closely with Product and Engineering on what partners need and what we can ship. title: Maintenance Optimization TPM, Availability Serviceability Team
description:
The AWS Data Center Availability Serviceability team works with hundreds of AWS data centers globally to deliver the highest quality and lowest cost availability, capacity, and scaling results for our customers. We standardize operations globally by delivering tools, policy, processes, and procedures to our internal teams.
Serviceability is the ability to maintain, repair, and manage infrastructure assets efficiently throughout their lifecycle -- encompassing maintenance standards, spares management, training and certifications, operational readiness, and the systematic use of data and automation to prevent disruptions and drive continuous improvement.
We are seeking a Maintenance Optimization Technical Program Manager to own how AWS data center infrastructure is maintained: which tasks, at what interval, with what controls, and why. The fleet runs thousands of preventive maintenance plans inherited from vendor manuals and historical practice. This role applies reliability-centered maintenance thinking to that inventory at fleet scale, deciding what each task protects against, whether the control fits the failure mode and its consequence, and where a human check can be replaced by telemetry or retired altogether.
Key job responsibilities
You will lead preventive maintenance optimization across equipment classes (electrical and mechanical), taking each change from failure-mode analysis through a revised maintenance standard to the published procedures technicians execute, with the labor and risk impact quantified. You will set the method: a repeatable, lightweight way to challenge a maintenance task (failure mode, consequence, existing detection, proposed control) that program managers across the team can run without you. Working with our monitoring, controls, and maintenance-planning teams, you will drive decisions on where remote telemetry can replace a physical inspection, removing a human check only when the data demonstrably covers it.
You will own decisions that most maintenance organizations never revisit. The problem is real engineering, not process administration: you will be asked why a task exists, what happens if it stops, and whether the data can prove it. You will work across EAM data, equipment telemetry, regulatory regimes, vendor warranty terms, and the physical gear itself, and you will do it inside the constraints of a live production fleet where being wrong has consequences. And you will build the capability in others. The TPMs you coach will carry this reasoning into every program they touch.
Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Preferred qualifications: - 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience applying reliability-centered maintenance methods (FMEA, task selection by failure mode and consequence, condition-based alternatives to calendar PMs) to a live fleet, including defending a change to an established maintenance standard.

description:
Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority. We are building a new generation of AI-native products to fundamentally change how Amazon identifies, understands, and eliminates the problems that create friction for selling partners. This is an opportunity to apply Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, and agentic AI to one of Amazon’s most complex problems: turning millions of fragmented seller signals into actionable intelligence and systematically eliminating the root causes behind them.
We are seeking a Senior Product Manager - Tech to lead a strategic AI initiative focused on reducing the need for selling partners WW to contact Amazon by systematically identifying and eliminating the root causes of seller friction. The initiative, Root Cause Elimination (RCE), will build an intelligent, end-to-end system that brings together seller signals across contacts, escalations, audits, and other mechanisms and uses AI to generate insights, identify and consolidate root causes, quantify and prioritize their impact, recommend preventive actions, and continuously validate whether those interventions eliminated the underlying seller problem. The vision is to move from teams manually finding and reacting to individual defects to an intelligent system that continuously learns from seller experiences and helps Amazon prevent those experiences from recurring.
From Day 1, this leader will have ownership of a large, ambiguous product space and the autonomy to define the product vision, AI strategy, technical roadmap, and customer experience. You will partner deeply with Engineering and Science to define LLM capabilities, agentic workflows, machine-learning models, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and AI evaluation frameworks, while building experiences that enable Policy and Program teams to turn AI-generated intelligence into action. You will make high-judgment decisions about where AI can automate work, where human judgment should remain in the loop, and how the system earns trust as it scales globally.
The Senior Product Manager-Tech will be a bar-raising product leader and communicator who thrives at the intersection of AI, technology, and complex business problems. This role requires the ability to clearly articulate complex problems and solutions, align teams toward clear priorities, advocate for investment, and establish mechanisms that measure progress against shared goals. You will collaborate across Product, Engineering, Science, Operations, Policy, and Program teams and influence leaders across multiple VP-level organizations.
This is a global role with significant interaction with teams outside the United States and the opportunity to build a product from its earliest stages. The decisions made in this role will directly shape the experience of selling partners, how Amazon uses AI to identify and eliminate systemic seller defects, and our ability to build seller trust at scale. The opportunity is not simply to make existing processes more efficient with AI, but to build a fundamentally different way of finding and eliminating seller problems before they generate repeated friction and contacts.

title: Graphics Software Content Engineer
description:
Do you love problem solving and creating elegant solutions to highly complex technical challenges? title: SOC Design Verification Engineer
description:
Apple’s wireless chip powers connectivity across every new iPhone — and its successor is already taking shape. Would you like to join Apple’s growing wireless silicon development team? Our wireless SOC organization owns every aspect of wireless silicon development, with a particular emphasis on highly energy-efficient design and new technologies that transform the user experience at the product level. It is driven by a world-class, vertically integrated team spanning RF/Analog, Systems/PHY/MAC, VLSI/RTL design and integration, Emulation, Design Verification, Test and Validation, and FW/SW engineering. As a Wireless SOC Design Verification Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of the chip design effort — owning a meaningful verification scope and growing it project to project.
You’ll be responsible for pre-silicon RTL verification at the block, subsystem, and top-level SOC, taking your scope from test planning through coverage closure and signoff. Working closely with architects, designers, and firmware engineers, you’ll build reusable testbenches and verification environments using modern, metric-driven methodology. Areas you may work on include the Power Management Unit, CPU subsystem, DMA, on-chip debug infrastructure, PCIe, bus fabric, boot and secure-boot sequencing, MAC-PHY Verification, Radio integration, and peripherals such as SPI — choosing simulation, formal, or whichever approach the design actually calls for. Low power is part of your scope wherever it shows up: you’ll verify power intent using UPF within your area.
Over time, you can grow deeper into the IPs and subsystems you know best, or broader — across IPs and up from block level to full SOC integration. The team is also pushing hard on AI-assisted verification, and you’ll help figure out where it fits best: test generation, debug, coverage closure, or all the above.
Minimum qualifications: Minimum requirement of a bachelors degree.
Hands-on experience across the verification cycle: test planning, testbench implementation, test creation and debug, and coverage closure.
Strong SystemVerilog and Verilog skills, with solid working knowledge of UVM.
Solid problem-solving and debugging skills with constrained-random verification.
Understanding of digital logic design, SOC architecture, and microarchitecture.
Preferred qualifications: Experience taking at least one ASIC/SOC from concept through tape-out.
Verification experience with PCIe, bus fabric/NOC, or AHB/AXI-based architectures in a UVM environment.
Experience verifying IP or top-level integration for a WiFi or Bluetooth SOC, or knowledge of wireless protocols.
Experience with low-power verification, UPF, boot-up, power-cycling, and HW/FW interaction.
Experience with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and/or formal tools (e.g., JasperGold).
Experience defining coverage space and writing coverage models.
Experience with embedded CPU verification; programming in C/C++ or assembly.
Scripting in Python or Perl; interest in applying AI/ML to verification workflows
Great teammate with excellent communication skills and the desire to take on diverse challenges.

title: Senior Compute Runtime Software Engineer
description:

title: Sr. Staff / Distinguished Engineer
description:
Imagine the web itself as your raw material — every page, every image, every signal of what’s new and what matters, flowing in at a scale most engineers only read about in systems papers.
At Apple, that scale is a daily reality. The data acquisition platform you’d help lead doesn’t just power search — it’s the sensory layer underneath Siri, Spotlight, Apple Maps, and the foundation models driving Apple Intelligence. Every one of those products depends on a continuous, exabyte-scale pipeline of fresh, high-quality information pulled from the live web, stored, and made usable in near real time.
As a Sr. Staff / Distinguished Engineer on this team, you won’t just build the pipes — you’ll shape the intelligence that decides what flows through them. This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems and machine learning: the hard problem isn’t only moving exabytes of data, it’s deciding what’s worth acquiring, how to score and prioritize it, and how to continuously improve that judgment as the web and Apple’s models evolve. You’ll work across engineering, AI research, and product teams to turn crawl and storage infrastructure into a system that gets smarter over time — one whose decisions directly shape the quality of the intelligence millions of people rely on through Apple’s products.
If you’re energized by distributed systems at their most extreme scale, know how to bring ML into the decisions that govern what data gets captured and how it’s valued, and want your judgment to shape the strategic direction of Apple’s AI data foundation, we want to talk to you.
This role owns technical strategy and execution for Apple’s web-scale data acquisition platform — the systems that crawl, store, and deliver exabytes of web content and images to power Siri, Spotlight, Apple Maps, and Apple’s foundation models. Responsibilities span the full lifecycle of acquired data: crawl strategy and prioritization, the ML-driven decisions about what’s worth capturing and how to value it, and the scalable storage and compute architecture that makes all of it usable downstream.
As a senior member of the technical staff, you will set direction on how Apple acquires data efficiently, broadly, and precisely at a scale that few infrastructure problems in the industry match. The hardest problems here live at the boundary between distributed systems and machine learning: designing storage and compute that let engineering teams move fast without being bottlenecked by data gravity, while applying ML to decide what to crawl, how to score quality and relevance, and how those decisions should evolve as the web and Apple’s models change. You’ll also shape how downstream teams consume what’s acquired, to maximize its value for search ranking and AI model training alike.
Success in this role depends on working across organizational boundaries — partnering with crawl infrastructure, search indexing, and AI/foundation model teams to align architecture and ML strategy with Apple’s broader AI direction. You’ll be expected to navigate ambiguous, large-scale technical tradeoffs independently, and to act as a trusted technical voice to senior leadership on direction, risk, and resourcing for one of Apple’s most foundational data platforms.
Minimum qualifications: 12+ years building and operating distributed systems at large scale (petabyte/exabyte-class storage, compute, or data pipelines)
Demonstrated experience applying machine learning to data quality, ranking, relevance, or prioritization problems in production
Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams as a senior lead — not just within a single team’s codebase
Experience partnering with ML/AI research teams to translate model needs into infrastructure and data requirements

title: Systems Engineer — Apple Reference Image
description:
Reference Image is one of Apple's most ambitious end-to-end security and imaging initiatives: a system that lets users cryptographically verify that a photo genuinely came from an Apple device sensor, unaltered. It spans everything from the image sensor, through on-device capture and RAW pipelines, to Private Cloud Compute (PCC) processing and signing, all the way to viewing and sharing experiences across iOS and macOS.
We're looking for a Systems Engineer to join the Reference Image team and own key pieces of the technical architecture and cross-stack integration, someone who can reason across hardware security, cloud infrastructure, and application-layer behavior. You'll work under the guidance of the project DRI, taking ownership of specific systems-level work streams while helping drive alignment across a distributed, multi-team effort toward a coherent, secure, and shippable system.
In this role you’ll be expected to:
* Contribute to and help maintain the systems architecture for Reference Image, spanning sensor-level signing, on-device RAW capture pipelines, and cloud-based development in PCC.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of cryptographic key rotation, certificate lifecycle management, and revocation frameworks.
* Work closely with Security and Privacy teams to help threat-model end-to-end media authenticity workflows, evaluating cryptographic integrity, data privacy, and downstream non-destructive edit handling.
* Help evaluate and advance standard and extended image container formats to support secure provenance and authenticity metadata.
* Coordinate with PCC/Cloud infrastructure teams on specific integration points to ensure the signing and certificate infrastructure scales and meets the security bar.
* Represent your work stream's technical tradeoffs in cross-functional forums (Photos, Camera Capture, ISP/hardware, QA, Privacy, Legal, Marketing), proactively identifying and resolving cross-team technical dependencies and blockers.
* Contribute to scoping and planning for future hardware generations under the direction of the DRI.
Minimum qualifications: BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field and 5+ years of experience in industry.
Familiarity with cryptographic signing/verification concepts (certificates, secure boot, key management, revocation) and comfort partnering closely with Security/Privacy teams.
Experience with image/media pipelines (RAW processing, ISP behavior, DNG/JPEG/HEIF formats) is a strong plus.
Experience with distributed cloud infrastructure and confidential compute environments (PCC or similar) preferred.

title: Wireless PHY Systems Engineer — Pre-Silicon Emulation
description:
Come join Apple's growing wireless silicon development team. Our wireless SoC organization is responsible for all aspects of wireless silicon development, with a particular emphasis on highly energy-efficient design and new technologies that transform the user experience at the product level. All of this is driven by a world-class vertically integrated engineering team spanning RF/Analog architecture and design, Systems/PHY/MAC architecture and design, VLSI/RTL design and integration, Emulation, Design Verification, Test and Validation, and FW/SW engineering. In this role, you will help de-risk our silicon well ahead of tape-out by owning the pre-silicon emulation environment that enables the team to exercise and verify new designs early and with confidence. We are looking for a wireless PHY systems engineer for this role: your understanding of the full signal chain, from RF and PHY through MAC and firmware, will help ensure that each emulated design not only comes up but behaves as intended. Prior Palladium experience is not required, and we will help the right candidate ramp up on the platform. If you enjoy a fast-paced and challenging environment, collaborate with people across different functional areas, and thrive during crisis times, we encourage you to apply.
This role is central to Apple's pre-silicon verification effort for wireless SoCs, centered on the Palladium emulation platform. You will be the first to bring up each newly released emulation build, and you will design and own the framework and infrastructure — register maps, initialization and boot sequences, clock and reset, and system-level configuration — that brings the emulated SoC into an operational state and enables the wider team to run their own design verification. Working at the intersection of digital design, firmware, and validation, you will own and evolve this infrastructure across successive silicon generations, while also contributing to pre-silicon emulation and lab bring-up of Bluetooth and UWB silicon.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree with 10 years of relevant experience.
Solid foundation in Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and wireless communications, with working knowledge of PHY and MAC layer concepts.
Hands-on software programming skills for system modeling, simulation, and test, with proficiency in MATLAB and C/C++.
Familiarity with analog/RF impairments common in wireless systems (e.g., phase noise, IQ imbalance, nonlinearity).
Experience with or knowledge of wireless standards such as Bluetooth, Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or other wireless protocols.
Experience collecting, processing, and visualizing large-scale simulation and test datasets, including performance metrics such as measurement accuracy, latency, and throughput.
Strong communication skills, both written and oral, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
Preferred qualifications: Master's degree with 10 years of relevant experience.
Hands-on experience in wireless chip or modem development, with a strong systems-level understanding of cross-layer dependencies between RF, PHY, MAC, and firmware.
Hands-on experience in Bluetooth and UWB systems design and validation.
Digital design fundamentals and a solid understanding of SoC architecture and system-level hardware/software interaction.
Hands-on RTL experience (Verilog/VHDL) and experience with register map and programming-model definition.
Experience with fixed-point design, RTL vector generation, and/or High-Level Synthesis (HLS).
Experience with pre-silicon emulation (e.g., Palladium) or FPGA prototyping, including build bring-up, debug, and performance characterization.
Experience developing validation frameworks and infrastructure, including initialization sequences, clock and reset setup, and system-level configuration.
Experience in lab FPGA/silicon bring-up, PHY/RF/MAC testing, and use of RF lab equipment.
Proficiency with Python for test automation and data analysis, and experience with simulation automation, regression frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines.
Experience collaborating with firmware and FPGA/emulation engineers to bring up, integrate, and debug hardware platforms, ensuring correct hardware/software interaction.

DUTIES
Always follow and comply with safe operating practices and procedures.
Travel to and perform work at customer location, with most of the work performed outside.
Perform scheduled preventative maintenance (“PM”), DOT Inspections and follow up repairs on light and medium vehicles in the field.
Perform routine maintenance such as changing oil, checking batteries, and lubricating equipment.
Use hand tools, precision instruments, as well as some Diesel tools, lifts, and jacks.
Perform minor adjustment and repairs on various types of customer vehicles, trucks, and equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Engines (gas only), Transmissions (manual and automatic) etc.
Diagnose, adjust, and repair various types of vehicles, trucks, and equipment including, but not limited to the following: Electrical/Brake/Cooling Systems, Starters/Alternators, Air conditioning systems, Fan clutches, Engine electronics, Diesel steering systems, Engines (gas only), Transmissions (manual and automatic), Clutches, Differentials, etc.
Inspect, test, and listen to defective equipment to diagnose malfunctions, using test instruments such as scanners and pressure gauges.
Identify problems, determine accuracy and relevance of information, using sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives.
Independently determining parts required for each job, ordering, and picking up the parts for installation.
Perform all work in compliance with organizational safety, health and environmental policies, and federal regulations, to include OSHA, EPA, and DOT.
Document according to company standards and upload pictures of work performed, parts used, and all findings observed on Repair Orders (“RO”) using company provided cellphone and on paper.
Accurately complete DOT forms and all other forms of documentation in a timely fashion, as applicable.
Maintain a clean and safe work environment.  Assist in cleanup at the end of each day for tools, parts, and equipment.
Apply knowledge that is acquired through formal training or on-the-job experience to perform one's job; works with, understands, and evaluates technical information related to the job.
Work with support team to assess customer needs, provide information or assistance, resolving their problems, or satisfying their expectations.
Manage concurrent assigned tasks, making effective judgments as to prioritizing work related activities and time allocations.
Act with integrity, demonstrate honesty and keep commitments. Behave in a consistent manner, keeping sensitive information confidential and adhering to ethical and professional standards.
Maintain a high level of productivity and be able to work within or close to most Standard Repair Times.
Communicate with support team in corporate offices to obtain approvals on repair estimates, retrieve purchase order numbers and/or discuss RO findings notes.
Participate and complete all-in company required safety training.
Maintain assigned service vehicle, conduct safety checks and daily pre/post trip inspections.
Adhere to company policies, processes, and procedures.

High School Diploma or GED preferred.
Safe drivers needed; valid driver’s license required.
Possess and supply a set of hand tools necessary to perform required job duties.
Minimum of one (1) year of experience as an Automotive Technician on light/medium vehicle repair or equivalent combination of technical education/certifications/skill/experiences.
2 years of equivalent experience in a similar capacity Technician role.
Participate in and complete all-in company required training.
SKILLS & ABILITIES
Understand the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.
Ability to lift, bend, climb, stand, and walk for long periods of time; ability to perform moderately heavy laboring work
Ability to exert oneself physically over long periods of time without tiring, which may include performing repetitive tasks.
Communicates information (for example, facts, ideas, or messages) in a succinct and organized manner.  Engages in effective two-way communication with individuals and groups.
Ability to determine the type of tools and equipment needed.
Ability to accurately judge which of several objects is closer or farther away from the observer, or the distance between an object and the observer.
Use logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

LEADERSHIP
Ownership of and accountability for successful results of the Data Warehouse & Business Intelligence teams within Data Transformation.
Thought leadership in matters of enterprise data architecture, staying abreast of new technologies, patterns and methods which c an be applicable to Crowe data
Development of team strategy, creation and socialization of roadmaps, establishing and ensuring adherence to timelines, and resource assignment for the BIDW team

Mentor and coach developers, data engineers, managers, and other roles within team, intentionally managing career growth via mentorship and proactive planning
Actively participate in and collaborate with technical guilds to further expose and align the firm on best practices
Understand when to delegate; this role manages resources and owns the entire team’s success
Responsibility to track and maintain clear visibility into the value and delivery timing of BIDW team initiatives for Head of Data and business stakeholders
DEMAND MANAGEMENT & BUSINESS ENGAGEMENT
Collaboration with Head of Data and/or other firm leaders to understand strategic business needs and requirements, and planning team and technology capacity accordingly
Communication and engagement to ensure the business sees maximum value from its data warehouse and business intelligence investments
Develop and maintain an understanding of business needs, technical architecture and systems landscape, and the technology strategy of the business
Collaborate with both BIDW team and Data Transformation leaders to establish goals, plan capacity, support other Data Transformation initiatives, and leave margin for learning and unexpected shifts
PROGRAM DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT & DEPLOYMENT
Ultimate ownership for team delivery quality and schedule
Work closely with technology and business personnel to deliver value in a timely manner
Accountability for team using best practices for development and quality assurance aligned with firmwide standards, seeking opportunities to automate and improve
CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT
Champion a culture and mindset of excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, design thinking and positivity
Establish metrics to monitor and tangibly demonstrate the value provided to the business via effectiveness, quality metrics, sensitive data monitoring as well as alert to any negative trends in these areas
Work with stakeholders to prioritize continuous improvement
Assess and recommend opportunities to retire/consolidate redundant legacy system assets
ADOPTION & VALUE REALIZATION
Work with team and business users to ensure successful adoption, usage, and benefit realization from solutions
Define and track KPIs and success metrics for adoption and value creation
Specific responsibility expectations by the components listed below –
Information Architecture Vision: Establish the Enterprise Information Architecture vision within the context of business strategy and in alignment with overall Technology & Strategy direction.
Translate strategic requirements into a usable enterprise information architecture, which may include an enterprise data model, common business vocabulary, ontology, and taxonomies, to guide enterprise solution development and achieve consistency of information assets.
Create an information architecture consistent with the business, application, and technical architectures.
Facilitate the mapping and traceability of information assets as they flow from source datastores to targets, thus ensuring optimal transparency, quality, consistency, and controlled redundancy.
Information Architecture Delivery: Work with and mentor delivery teams to provide data solutions that are in keeping with the enterprise information architecture. This may include:
Assessing suitability of vendor solutions to meet enterprise information requirements.
Construct, refine and maintain information models, as needed, to meet business requirements and drive data designs for operational and analytical solutions.
Facilitate the definition of integrative and canonical views of data or information across multiple content types to support convergence of information asset migration planning or impact analysis.
Ensure new development is consistent and well-integrated with the established enterprise information architecture, using metadata management and/or a repository to promote reuse and standards adoption.
Review corporate data sources for new business information and better data sources. Assist in post-implementation improvement efforts to enhance performance and provide increased functionality.
Participate in key project design reviews as part of the methodology process to ensure application designs adhere to enterprise information architecture guidelines.
Provide oversight for the BI Data Warehouse. Design an enterprise-wide integrated Data Warehouse for
Business Intelligence by modeling new and enhancing existing BIDW datamarts. Establish logical and physical models, maintain metadata, and guide integration engineers for the physical datamart schema and logical integration (ETL) processes. Assist, as required, with testing and issue resolution. Establish and enhance governance processes for the BI Data Warehouse (naming conventions, conformed dimensions and facts, meta-models, security configuration) to ensure a consistent implementation across all datamarts.
On large implementation projects, deliver project artifacts including: Data Integration Inventory, 360 Data Integration Diagram, Core structures diagram, Data Integration Requirements document and Test Plans, Report Inventory, Reporting Gap Analysis and Strategy, and Historical Data Strategy
Business Intelligence Team Leadership: Provide leadership, oversight, and quality assurance for BI Team and team deliverables. This may include:
Manage and coach BI team members in delivery of high-quality business intelligence solutions. Assist to estimate effort / duration for new requests and change orders. Track work queue, assign and adjust priorities and due dates based on client requirements and DT Leadership direction. Provide BI team with visibility to DT projects and project pipeline. Provide a forum for BI team collaboration on BI and Data Warehouse design and technical challenges.
Establish, document, and maintain best practices for Business Intelligence and Data Warehousing.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Data/Information Science, Information Systems, Mathematics (or other related fields)
6+ years of experience with SQL
4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, data analysis, and reporting
4+ years of experience with Microsoft Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and M language.
2+ years of experience with Python (or other programming languages)
4+ years of experience managing projects from inception to execution.
Preferred Qualifications
Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certifications preferred.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence concepts, Data Quality, and the related technology landscape, processes, and design principles
Proven track record in operating large data warehouse and business intelligence programs
Experience in managing enterprise data assets in a large, complex organization
Should be familiar with cloud and data management trends and methodologies
Ability to analyze complex situations and to derive workable actions
Ability to constructively challenge requirements and current state to increase overall value to the firm
Strong relationship building skills
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change
Good written and verbal communication
Strong analytical and time management skills
Strong facilitation skills with the ability to drive issues to closure
Self-motivated and able to handle tasks with minimal supervision or questions
Ability to compare technologies and make recommendations to senior members of the team
Understanding of privacy laws and regulations
